source: obd-discover, 2 on-car captures 2026-08; VIN pattern read from the vehicle
notes: 1,929 identifiers across 40 blocks, 17,441 probes. Work Truck, 6.6L V8, 4WD crew cab. The VIN was NOT read during the scan -- the 29-bit VIN path was sending 7DF/7E0, which do not exist on that bus -- so the pattern was read off the vehicle afterwards and pairs with this capture on the owner's identification, not on a fingerprint in the map.
